text:
Noah K: Quick flag  partner HelixSys (SI + infra) says theyre getting demo leads from our cloud marketplace in EMEA and expect to own follow-up. Who owns outreach by policy?

Ivy L: Default: marketplace demo requests -> Redwood SDR/BizDev owns first contact. Partners can claim only with timestamped evidence or partner_referral_upload. HelixSys picked this up via the marketplace "choose a partner" step, so it's fuzzy.

Rahul T: For hardware/SI combos we should treat partner_contribution as a first-class field. If partner supplies on-site HW or pays for booth/intro, they get stronger claim weight.

Jordan (SI Ops): Proposed compact policy: 1) lead.origin == marketplace & partner_tagged -> BizDev has soft ownership for claim_window hours; 2) partner tiers set claim_window (Premier=24h, Standard=48h); 3) partner_contribution in [onsite_hw, paid_intro] -> reduce window by 50%; 4) estimated_ARR >= 300k -> always route to Redwood SDR for qualification.

Clara Legal: Capture proof artifacts and retain 12 months. If partner MSA has explicit "introduced account" language mark contract_entitlement=true in mapping. Ill check HelixSys MSA for carveouts.

Noah K: Also need a simple human-review exception: if ARR within 20% of threshold or risk_flags present (NDA_needed, data_residency, on_prem_hw) route to #partnerships-claims for 24h triage.

Ivy L: For partner claims require either: a) signed webhook with partner HMAC, schema below; or b) screenshot of marketplace lead card showing partner selection + timestamp + user email. No screenshot = no claim.

Rahul T: Sample webhook payload we can require (HMAC):
{
  "lead_id": "<uuid>",
  "partner_id": "helixsys",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T09:12:34Z",
  "proof_url": "https://s3.redwood/proofs/abcd.png",
  "signature": "HMAC-SHA256( payload, partner_key )"
}
We should validate signature server-side and log the raw request.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo: 
- if (lead.origin=="partner_referral_upload" && proof_valid) owner=partner;
- else claim_window = partner_tier_window * (partner_contribution==onsite?0.5:1);
- if (no outreach by Redwood within claim_window && proof_valid) owner=partner else owner=Redwood;
- if (estimated_ARR>=300k) owner=Redwood;
- if (risk_flags) escalate to #partnerships-claims.

Ivy L: We'll add Confluence mapping fields: partner, tier, claim_window_hours, partner_contribution, arr_override_threshold, proof_required(boolean), contract_entitlement_flag, risk_flags, proof_example_url. Include CSV/JSON export and sample webhook.

Clara Legal: Action: I'll draft a short addendum template for partners who want formal claim rights (minimum commitment + SLA). Also confirm evidence retention policy.

Noah K: Product/marketing ask: joint announcement gating  any co-marketing with SI/hardware partner must have product sign-off and 10 business days prep. If hardware involved, add security review and 15 business days. Exceptions for strategic enterprise deals with exec sign-off.

Rahul T: CRM change: add lead.badges: partner_claim_status (pending/accepted/contested), partner_claim_proof_url, partner_tech_contact. When partner claim accepted, auto-add partner_tech_contact to lead contacts.

Jordan (SI Ops): Escalation flow for contested claims: 1) ops triage in #partnerships-claims within 48h, 2) if unresolved and ARR >= 250k escalate to Legal for arbitration.

Ivy L: I'll draft the Confluence page + intake template + example webhook by Friday and seed HelixSys entries (EMEA) for the 30-day pilot. Include sample screenshots and HMAC validation notes.

Clara Legal: I'll check HelixSys MSA today and loop Legal in.

Marketplace-bot: Note: Partnership intake form updated -> new field partner_contribution. See https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/claims for draft.

Noah K: Thanks all. Pilot HelixSys for 30 days, measure contested_rate and time_to_first_contact. Keep schema machine-readable to enable automation later.

Jordan (SI Ops): I'll add the pseudo-code to SI Ops playbook and set up #partnerships-claims.

Ivy L: tagging Rahul + Clara for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
